title: Jubilee!
tagline: A Bible-story property game for the whole family!
description: Buy Bible lands from Bethlehem to the New Jerusalem, build houses and hotels, charge rent, and dodge the Dungeon. A full property-trading board game with Bible-story places and players, for phones and the TV. Classic rules with family rule options, scribe AI opponents, room codes for friends, and a big-screen TV stage.
how_to: Open on your phone in Jarvis (or cast /jubilee/tv to a big screen) and join the 4-letter Family Room Code!
Roll the dice and buy Bible lands. Own a whole colour group to build houses and hotels and charge bigger rents.
Land on PARABLE or SCRIPTURE for a card. Three doubles in a row sends you to the Dungeon.
Pass Jubilee! to collect $200. Last family standing wins - or highest net worth when the rounds run out!
